label: Rival-side reading for #512/#497: Papineau, The Rise of Physicalism and Hume, Enquiry IV, V, VII…
summary: Rival-side reading for #512/#497: Papineau, The Rise of Physicalism (passages PAPINEAU-RISE-PHYSICALISM-3-12 and the new PAPINEAU-RISE-PHYSICALISM-13-33, pp.3-33, both materialized and read) and Hume, Enquiry IV, V, VII and Treatise I.3.3, I.3.6 (all materialized and read), checked against each of the 49 root-path premises of origin/main ef4e6fe1. Result: neither author states or denies any of the 49 in the case vocabulary. Two genuine readings bear on a premise and were recorded. (1) Hume, Treatise I.3.6 §7: 'the same principle cannot be both the cause and effect of another' (claim HUME-TREATISE-I-3-6-NO-MUTUAL-CAUSE-A, STMT-HUME-NO-MUTUAL-CAUSE). It is a consequence of STMT-CAUSAL-HISTORY-HAS-NO-LOOPS and strictly weaker (result HUME-NO-MUTUAL-CAUSE-FROM-NO-LOOPS: entailment plus a self-cause and a Fin 3 three-cycle countermodel to the converse): Hume attests a consequence, not the premise. (2) Papineau p.8, endorsed pp.32-33: the completeness of physics (claim PAPINEAU-RISE-COMPLETENESS-OF-PHYSICS-A). With two unattributed open bridges (STMT-PHYSICAL-MOTION-IS-PHYSICAL-EFFECT, STMT-PRIOR-PHYSICAL-DETERMINATION-GIVES-MOVER) it yields STMT-EVERY-PHYSICAL-MOTION-HAS-A-PER-SE-MOVER (result PAPINEAU-COMPLETENESS-PHYSICAL-MOTION-MOVER, a single-application transcription with premisesNeeded), which reaches STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER only through the existing open scope premise. A conditional agreement on the mover premise for physical motion, resting on reading prior lawful determination as a present mover. Per premise, P = Papineau, H = Hume; silent unless noted. CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: silent; rejected H Enquiry IV §§9-11 'the effect is totally different from the cause' as a denial, since it concerns a priori discoverability of the effect in the idea of the cause. MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS, MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING: silent. POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY: silent; H's unknown secret powers (IV §16, VII §§8, 26) are an epistemic limit, and VII §27 and T I.3.6 §§8-10 keep the word power meaningful, so no denial of capacities. ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING, NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING: silent. CAUSE-OF-BEING-CAUSES-EVERY-PERFECTION: silent; H VII §22 'nothing exists but by his will' is a report of the occasionalists' starting principle, not Hume's assertion. CAUSAL-FINITE-IMMEDIATE-PREDECESSORS, CAUSAL-WELL-FOUNDED-PREDECESSORS, PER-SE-LINKS-IN-FINITE-HISTORY-RELATION: silent. CAUSAL-HISTORY-HAS-NO-LOOPS: H states a strictly weaker consequence (reading 1); P silent. NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT: silent. GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE: silent. PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK: H withholds about occasionalism (VII §§24-25: too bold to carry conviction; no force in its arguments), reports it second-hand (§21, as already recorded in ATTEMPT-RIVAL-TRIAGE-497) and reports in note D that Newton, Locke, Clarke and Cudworth grant second causes real derived power; no assertion either way. AS-TO-BEING-SO-TO-TRUTH, GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM: silent. THINGS-MORE-AND-LESS-GOOD-TRUE-NOBLE: silent (P pp.11-12 leaves noncausal realms of moral worth and beauty open). SECOND-MOVERS-MOVE-ONLY-AS-MOVED: silent; H VII §14 and P p.13 describe temporal chains of events (will, animal spirits, muscles; brain, nerves, arm), not a simultaneous per se series. BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY: silent. EVERY-MOTION-NATURAL-OR-FORCED, NATURAL-MOTION-SELF-OR-PASSIVE, NATURAL-SELF-MOTION-HAS-A-MOVER, PASSIVE-NATURAL-MOTION-BY-GENERATOR-OR-REMOVER, PER-ACCIDENS-MOVED-PASSIVE-MOTION-HAS-PER-SE-MOVER: silent; neither uses the natural/forced division. FORCED-MOTION-BY-ANOTHER: silent; rejected reading H note D ('a body at rest or in motion continues for ever in its present state, till put from it by some new cause') and IV §16 as a denial: it speaks of no forced motion, and it denies only a new cause of continuing, not a mover, unless uniform motion is read as a being moved (DISAMB-MOTION); its conditional content parallels NEWTON-PRINCIPIA-LEX-I-A and was not claimed. GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING: silent. EVERY-CREATED-AGENT-ACTS-AS-APPLIED-TO-ACT-BY-GOD: silent; the conditional clash with Papineau's completeness and restricted physicalism suggested in #512 was checked and rejected: the formal statement (an agent whose being God causes is itself moved when it moves) does not say that God moves it, so the clash would need the unformalized 'by God' plus God being nonphysical in Papineau's sense; H VII §22 argues against occasionalism ('more power in the Deity to delegate a certain degree of power to inferior creatures'), which is compatible with q.105 a.5 concurrence. ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY: silent. EVERY-REDUCTION-TO-ACT-IS-PHYSICAL-MOTION: silent; rejected reading P's restricted physicalism (pp.11-12: everything that interacts causally with the physical world is physical) as this scope premise, since the two senses of physical differ (DISAMB-PHYSICAL) and identifying mental with physical occurrences does not make understanding a motion in place, quality or quantity. SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD: presupposed, not stated: H VII §6 (motion in the second billiard ball is what appears to the outward senses) and IV §16 (sight conveys an idea of the actual motion of bodies); P p.13 (movements of molecules in your arm). Not claimed: it would need an appearance-to-reality step for Hume and the reading of local motion as a being moved, both unattributed. NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER: P conditional agreement for physical motion (reading 2); H withholds only demonstrability of 'whatever begins to exist must have a cause' (T I.3.3, existing claims) and traces the opinion to experience (§9). COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE, MATTER-FORM-AND-ESSE-ESSENCE-ARE-COMPOSITIONS, GOODNESS-IS-ACTUALITY: silent. PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE: silent; rejected H IV §11 'every effect is a distinct event from its cause' as a denial, since distinct events are compatible with formal or eminent preexistence and the context is epistemic. IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL: silent; P's physicalism bears on the converse (whatever has intellect is immaterial), which is not this premise. IMMUTABLE-IS-ETERNAL, SUBSISTENT-BEING-IS-INFINITE, WILL-FOLLOWS-INTELLECT, CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE: silent. Stage 3 (PILOT-JESUS-CLAIMS, PILOT-ROSE, BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD, BRIDGE-GOD-FOUNDED-AUTHORITY-PROPOSES-ONLY-TRUTH, CATHOLIC-CHURCH-DEFINITIVELY-PROPOSES-CREED, CHRIST-FOUNDED-VISIBLE-CHURCH, CHRISTS-CHURCH-IS-THE-CATHOLIC-CHURCH, JESUS-CLAIMED-DIVINE-AUTHORITY-AND-ROSE, REVELATION-POSSIBLE-AND-RECOGNIZABLE): silent in these passages; Hume's Enquiry X on miracles would bear on PILOT-ROSE and REVELATION-POSSIBLE-AND-RECOGNIZABLE but is not pinned. Not claimed: Papineau's restricted physicalism and the causal argument (pp.9-12), his conservation-law history (pp.14-31), and Hume's note D inertia sentence: genuine readings, but none states or denies a root premise. blocker: Rival attestation of the 49 premises needs other texts: Hume's Enquiry X (miracles) and XII, Dialogues IX (necessary being), occasionalist primaries (Malebranche, al-Ghazali), and Newton/inertia readings of uniform motion as a being moved; none is pinned or claimed here.
